name: ESS Sabre
_note: Never bit-exact, in PCM or DSD: everything goes through its internal DSP. Author: "ESS is out since it's always through DSP". Consequence: not correctable. That is the ONLY consequence - it does not follow that the part re-converts DSD to PCM, and the same author recommends DSD output to ESS parts. See dsd_reconverted_to_pcm.
_dsd_reconverted_to_pcm: Not established by the family note, which concludes only that nothing is bit-exact. The reference software's author recommends DSD output to ESS parts by name - fifth-order modulation before the ES9039 - which he would not do for a converter that undoes the work. So: not re-converted, and not correctable.
